title: Flurl
description: Flurl is a fluent URL builder and HTTP client library for .NET. It lets you build URLs and make HTTP requests using a chainable, readable syntax.

data.text: Flurl is a fluent library for building URLs and making HTTP calls. Its chainable API makes constructing complex URLs and reading JSON responses feel natural and concise.

data.title: Building URLs and Making Requests
data.content: Use Flurl to build a URL and POST JSON.

terms.definition: A chainable interface where each method returns an object that can be chained to the next call.
Adds a segment to a URL path, handling slashes correctly.
Adds or replaces a query string parameter.

data.title: Flurl Client Reuse
data.text: Use Flurl.Configure(settings => settings.HttpClientFactory = ...) to manage HttpClient lifetimes and avoid socket exhaustion.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Flurl uses a fluent, chainable syntax for URLs and HTTP
It integrates with HttpClient lifetimes via settings
data.takeaway: Flurl makes building and calling HTTP APIs feel effortless.

data.title: Exercise: Query a Public API
data.description: Use Flurl to fetch and display data from a public API.
steps: Create a console app and install Flurl.Http
Call https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts with a userId query parameter
Deserialize the response into a list of posts
Print the title and body of each post
data.expectedOutcome: Console displays filtered posts fetched with a fluent Flurl request.
